turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail: e Concierge: For your first day with Invisalign clear aligners: - Wear them for about 20–22 hours a day, removing them only for eating, brushing, and flossing, unless your doctor gives you different instructions. - Keep them clean. The best method is Invisalign Cleaning Crystals. As an alternative, use a soft toothbrush with mild toothpaste and lukewarm water, then rinse and dry the aligners thoroughly before reinserting them. - Follow your doctor’s instructions so your treatment stays on track.
